# Version 4.155.0 (Unreleased)
> **m155 platform readiness**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 readies the m155 line with restored Linux font discovery and updated platform build support. Linux no-dependencies deployments can again locate system fonts, while Windows and Tizen native build configurations move to current supported toolchains.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **m155 core fork cleanup integrated** — Updates the bundled Skia fork integration for the current m155 development line. ([#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux system-font discovery restored** — NoDependencies deployments on Linux can again discover and use fonts installed on the system. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **Windows and Tizen native builds updated** — Windows builds align with the v143 toolset, and Tizen 10 native assets are built and packaged with GCC 14.2. ([#5238](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5238), [#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
